items.title: Is Equinix (EQIX) Reasonable With Cash Flow Riding On Expansion?
items.summary: Equinix has ridden a strong multi year upswing in its share price, so the live question is whether the cash the business can produce really supports the current market tag. items.title: Green Bond Raise Might Change The Case For Investing In Equinix (EQIX)
items.summary: Equinix issued €2.5b of green senior notes across four euro tranches and opened its SG6 AI-ready data center in Singapore, while extending AI security partnerships and appointing a new Malaysia head. The combination of large-scale green financing and AI-focused capacity additions gives Equinix more room to fund power-hungry workloads while keeping sustainability targets front and center. items.title: Equinix (EQIX) Lands First Silicon Spin Quantum Computer And €2.5 Billion Green Bond
items.summary: Equinix (NasdaqGS:EQIX) has hosted Diraq's world-first silicon spin quantum computer inside one of its data centers, marking an early commercial deployment alongside traditional infrastructure. The Diraq system uses silicon spin qubits that are designed to be compatible with existing semiconductor processes, targeting more efficient scaling within Equinix facilities. Equinix has issued €2.5b in green bonds, its largest such offering, to fund decarbonization and resource efficiency projects...

items.title: This data center stock remains a Top Pick, Deutsche Bank says
